title: stt-cs4 set manifest (hashes and ids only; never audio, never reference text)

label.description: Mandatory. Headline gates come only from private sets; the two are never pooled.

reference_version.description: Bumped on any reference_text_sha256 change; every arm is rescored.

audio_root.description: private: on-disk path outside every git work tree (e.g. under /mnt/raid0/llm/data/)

reference_protocol_label.description: e.g. 'single-rater' (DP-C default b) or 'two-rater-adjudicated' (DP-C recommendation a). Required when confirmation=true.

frozen_manifest_sha256.description: sha256 of canonical JSON (sorted keys, compact separators) of this manifest without this field. Required when confirmation=true; set before any arm is scored.

fillers_in_ref.description: DP-B default (b): fillers scored as ordinary words; flagged here.
